prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 39.8 °C (28% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.1 °C (23% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 46.4 °C (19% above healthy). Moderate fluid temperature rise and diminished heat exchange indicate degraded cooler efficiency.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.86 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.36 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.3 % (4% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.3 bar (within 1% of healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
